commits.message:
fix(transitions): clear view-transition names once a transition is over

The names were set for a navigation and never removed, so a theme switch
captured the named elements separately, and after going back and opening a
different project two cards could share a name, which makes the browser skip
the transition. Clear the names when the transition settles (skipped or
finished), clear leftovers before naming, and clear on a back/forward-cache
restore. Tests record the names during a real navigation and fail on the old
script.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
